entities.name: Ana María Zeno
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana María Zeno de Luque (1922–2011) was an Argentine professor, gynaecologist, sexologist, and women's rights activist who specialized in sexual education and social medicine. She was a founding member of the "Rosarina Association of Sexual Education" (ARES), and of the Kinsey Institute of Sexology Rosario.
